item.description: apipeek wraps mitmproxy into a one-click packet capture tool: it starts an HTTP/HTTPS proxy, embeds the mitmweb UI for live request/response inspection, and logs each request as one JSONL line in requests.jsonl. Useful for debugging, API integration testing, and authorized traffic analysis.

item.title: [infoq] DeepSeek 发布多模态模型，“小鲸鱼”长出了眼睛
item.description: DeepSeek launched an experimental multimodal model, deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, marking its first official API support for image understanding. Images are converted to tokens — up to 384 per image — and billed at the same rate as V4-Flash. Compared with V4-Flash-0731, most benchmarks improved (e.g., +5.6 on Toolathlon, +4.9 on DeepSWE), bringing text-agent performance close to Opus 4.8. API calls support Chat Completions, Messages, and Responses, with base64, URL, or Files API image input.
